steps.en: A summary report is produced for IDs under the indicator
steps.id: Laporan ringkasan dibuat untuk ID yang kena indicator
steps.why_en: Report comes from a monthly check cycle, not when the indicator is set, and needs fresh results.
steps.why_id: Laporan datang dari siklus cek bulanan, bukan saat indicator dipasang, dan butuh hasil baru.

steps.en: Report shows the offender's ID and name
steps.id: Laporan menampilkan ID dan nama offender

steps.en: Report shows the date of the last check against the agency
steps.id: Laporan menampilkan tanggal cek terakhir ke instansi
steps.why_en: A response date exists, but the agency named in the story cannot be confirmed.
steps.why_id: Tanggal respons ada, tapi instansi yang disebut story tidak bisa dipastikan.

steps.en: Report shows the last known registered address
steps.id: Laporan menampilkan alamat terdaftar terakhir yang diketahui

steps.en: Officer can use the report to follow up with the agency
steps.id: Officer bisa memakai laporan untuk follow up ke instansi
steps.why_en: File is stored, but the email is switched off in production and the staff report page looks broken.
steps.why_id: File tersimpan, tapi email dimatikan di produksi dan halaman laporan staff tampak bermasalah.
